system_prompt_style.note: No prompt-building code in the evidence bundle. The README mentions Persona (SOUL / PROFILE) and Agent Modes, which suggests composition, but the mechanism is not shown.

env_context_strategy.note: No task template or tool list in the evidence. The file tree lists GlobSearchCard/GrepSearchCard/ReadFileCard UI cards, which hints at navigation tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Every turn persisted; evicted turns indexed with on-demand recall — nothing summarized away.
context_compaction.note: Scroll Context evicts old turns, which can be recalled on demand. truncate_oldest is the closest value. The implementation file was not in the bundle.

observation_format.note: No observation-conversion code in the bundle. The file tree includes computer_use accessibility_tree.rs and capture.rs, which hints at a11y_tree and screenshots.

tool_call_format.note: No parser or LLM client code in the bundle.

tool_count.note: No tool registry in the bundle; the file tree was truncated at 400 of 4641 paths.

edit_primitive.note: The file tree shows EditFileCard/WriteFileCard/AppendFileCard UI cards, but no tool definitions.

tool_schema_source.note: No schema code in the bundle. The README says MCP integration exists.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Protocol-neutral MCP / A2A / ACP connector layer with encrypted credentials and per-call policy gate.
protocol_standardization.note: other = ACP (Agent Communication Protocol). Sourced from README prose only.

loop_primitives.note: The README mentions 'Advanced agent loop templates (Coding Mode, Mission Mode...)', but no run loop is in the bundle.

multi_agent_topology.note: The README says 'Sub-agents at runtime' and 'Spawn independent agents', but the default topology is not shown.

delegation_mechanism.note: subagent_spawn appears reachable per the README ('Sub-agents at runtime'), but the default is unknown.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Configurable approval levels: STRICT / SMART / AUTO / OFF.
human_in_loop.note: Access Policy can 'request human approval for each capability call'. The default level is not shown.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Continuously turns conversations and resources into readable, editable, searchable, and linked Markdown memory.
long_term_memory.note: Markdown memory via ReMe gives file_notes; the Skills library/marketplace gives skill_library. A vector store is on the roadmap, so it is not coded.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: qwenpaw tui --resume <id> # resume a previous session

rollback.note: Only the v2.1.0 news line mentions workspace checkpoints; the file tree also contains console/src/api/modules/checkpoints.ts. The mechanism is not shown.

cost_controls.note: tokenUsage modules exist, but no budget is shown.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Kernel-level execution isolation using Seatbelt (macOS), Bubblewrap / Landlock (Linux), and AppContainer (Windows). Shell commands run inside a restricted filesystem view.
execution_isolation.note: A host-kernel sandboxed subprocess is the closest value. Whether the sandbox is on by default is unclear, since governance lists allow/deny/ask/sandbox. A Docker deployment exists for the whole app.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: blocks agent access to sensitive files and directories (default-protects `~/.qwenpaw.secret/`, `~/.ssh`, etc.)
filesystem_access.note: Relative to the host/sandbox boundary; File Guard acts as a path denylist.

permission_model.evidence_quote: YAML rule engine with `ShellEvasionGuardian` inspects every tool call before execution

eval_hooks.note: The file tree was truncated, so no evaluation runner could be checked.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Dangerous commands are blocked before they run.
guardrails.note: input_filters is based on the Skill Scanner, which 'Detects prompt injection' (low confidence).

target_domain.note: Primarily a personal assistant with MCP; code workspace and browser/computer use are also shipped.

open_source.evidence_quote: QwenPaw is released under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE).

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Also works with Ollama, LM Studio, or 14+ cloud providers.

first_release_date.note: Date of the major v2 release from README news; no tag data was available. v1.x existed earlier.
